purpose: Establish an auditable pre-Core-Two baseline for repository structure, production invention evidence, data quality, and synthetic capability-graph performance.

repository_snapshot.source: GitHub tree scan before Core-Two branch changes

core_zero.evidence_interpretation: The absence of core-zero/guardian/rules.yaml is an integration gap. It does not establish that Mind imported or enforced an external Guardian policy.

core_one.baseline_interpretation: No production invention receipts or created library source files were observed in the inspected baseline inventory.

average_time_to_invent_ms.reason: Historical production invention timing measurements were unavailable.

average_human_merge_time_ms.reason: Historical human-review and merge-time measurements were unavailable.

production_safety_score.reason: No validated production safety-scoring dataset was available.

synthetic_replay.scope: graph traversal phase only; not end-to-end invention latency
synthetic_replay.interpretation: The candidate reduced measured graph-traversal time in this synthetic replay. This result does not establish equivalent gains in full invention latency, research, artifact generation, safety, correctness, or production throughput.

repository_inventory_snapshot.runtime_mirror_scope_note: Runtime Mirror inventories the local full checkout, including ignored audit paths. The values in this record describe the baseline tracked Git tree scan, not the complete local runtime filesystem.
repository_inventory_snapshot.invention_inventory_note: The absence of production invention artifacts in this baseline inventory must not be interpreted as proof that future or external runtime artifacts do not exist.

derived_recommendations.recommendation: Resolve the observed Core-Zero Guardian-policy gap and verify the actual policy loading and enforcement path.
Introduce durable invention receipts that distinguish attempted, blocked, failed, staged, reviewed, merged, and production-verified outcomes.
derived_recommendations.basis: Historical production receipts and lifecycle measurements were unavailable.

derived_recommendations.recommendation: Measure end-to-end invention time and each major processing phase separately.
derived_recommendations.basis: The supplied benchmark covers graph traversal only.

derived_recommendations.recommendation: Collect verified part-level BOM evidence before reporting average invention costs or cost savings.
Report tracked Git inventory, local runtime inventory, ignored files, generated proposals, and production tools as separate inventory categories.
derived_recommendations.basis: The baseline tracked-tree inventory and Runtime Mirror inventory have different scopes.

derived_recommendations.recommendation: Reproduce the graph benchmark with more rounds, controlled execution conditions, and correctness checks before using it as a release-level performance claim.
derived_recommendations.basis: The supplied synthetic replay used five rounds.

limitations: This record describes a historical baseline snapshot, not the current repository or runtime state.
No historic production invention receipts were present in the inspected baseline evidence.
Unknown invention time, BOM cost, human merge time, and safety scores remain null.
The synthetic offline_vault fixture is not counted as a Core-One production invention.
The graph traversal benchmark is not an end-to-end invention benchmark.
The absence of a tracked changelog or audit-log path does not prove that no untracked or external logs exist.
The missing Core-Zero Guardian rules file is an integration gap, not evidence that Mind imported a policy.
